versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י קַח־לְךָ֖ גִּלָּי֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וּכְתֹ֤ב עָלָיו֙ בְּחֶ֣רֶט אֱנ֔וֹשׁ לְמַהֵ֥ר שָׁלָ֖ל חָ֥שׁ בַּֽז׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;
controles.kjv: Moreover the Lord said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man’s pen concerning Maher–shalal–hash–baz.
controles.livre: Disse-me também o SENHOR: Toma para ti um grande letreiro, e escreve nele com pena para uso humano: Maer-Salal- Has-Baz.

versos.hebraico: וְאָעִ֣ידָה לִּ֔י עֵדִ֖ים נֶאֱמָנִ֑ים אֵ֚ת אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ בֶּ֥ן יְבֶרֶכְיָֽהוּ׃

controles.web: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”
controles.kjv: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
controles.livre: Então tomei comigo testemunhas fiéis: o sacerdote Urias, e Zacarias filho de Jeberequias.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶקְרַב֙ אֶל־הַנְּבִיאָ֔ה וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י קְרָ֣א שְׁמ֔וֹ מַהֵ֥ר שָׁלָ֖ל חָ֥שׁ בַּֽז׃

controles.web: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then Yahweh said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’
controles.kjv: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the Lord to me, Call his name Maher–shalal–hash–baz.
controles.livre: E vim até a profetisa, que concebeu e teve um filho; e o SENHOR me disse: Chama o nome dele de Maer-Salal-Has-Baz,

versos.hebraico: כִּ֗י בְּטֶ֨רֶם֙ יֵדַ֣ע הַנַּ֔עַר קְרֹ֖א אָבִ֣י וְאִמִּ֑י יִשָּׂ֣א׀ אֶת־חֵ֣יל דַּמֶּ֗שֶׂק וְאֵת֙ שְׁלַ֣ל שֹׁמְר֔וֹן לִפְנֵ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃ס

controles.web: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father,’ and, ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”
controles.kjv: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.
controles.livre: porque antes que o menino saiba falar “papai” ou “mamãe”, as riquezas de Damasco e os despojos de Samaria serão tomados pelo rei da Assíria.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣סֶף יְהוָ֔ה דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛י ע֖וֹד לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to me yet again, saying,
controles.kjv: The Lord spake also unto me again, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR continuou a a falar comigo, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: יַ֗עַן כִּ֤י מָאַס֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֚ת מֵ֣י הַשִּׁלֹ֔חַ הַהֹלְכִ֖ים לְאַ֑ט וּמְשׂ֥וֹשׂ אֶת־רְצִ֖ין וּבֶן־רְמַלְיָֽהוּ׃

controles.web: “Because this people have refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
controles.kjv: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
controles.livre: Dado que este povo rejeitou as águas de Siloé, que correm calmamente, e se alegrou com Resim e com o filho de Remalias,

versos.hebraico: וְלָכֵ֡ן הִנֵּ֣ה אֲדֹנָי֩ מַעֲלֶ֨ה עֲלֵיהֶ֜ם אֶת־מֵ֣י הַנָּהָ֗ר הָעֲצוּמִים֙ וְהָ֣רַבִּ֔ים אֶת־מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר וְאֶת־כָּל־כְּבוֹד֑וֹ וְעָלָה֙ עַל־כָּל־אֲפִיקָ֔יו וְהָלַ֖ךְ עַל־כָּל־גְּדוֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.
controles.kjv: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
controles.livre: Por isso eis que o Senhor fará subir sobre eles as águas do rio fortes e impetuosas: que é o rei da Assíria com todo o sua glória; e subirá sobre todas as suas correntes de águas, e transbordará por todas as suas margens;

versos.hebraico: וְחָלַ֤ף בִּֽיהוּדָה֙ שָׁטַ֣ף וְעָבַ֔ר עַד־צַוָּ֖אר יַגִּ֑יעַ וְהָיָה֙ מֻטּ֣וֹת כְּנָפָ֔יו מְלֹ֥א רֹֽחַב־אַרְצְךָ֖ עִמָּ֥נוּ אֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through; it will reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of its wings will fill the breadth of your land, Immanuel.
controles.kjv: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
controles.livre: E passará por Judá, e o inundará, chegando até o pescoço; e ao estender suas asas, encherá a largura de tua terra, ó Emanuel.

versos.hebraico: רֹ֤עוּ עַמִּים֙ וָחֹ֔תּוּ וְהַֽאֲזִ֔ינוּ כֹּ֖ל מֶרְחַקֵּי־אָ֑רֶץ הִתְאַזְּר֣וּ וָחֹ֔תּוּ הִֽתְאַזְּר֖וּ וָחֹֽתּוּ׃

controles.web: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!
controles.kjv: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.
controles.livre: Ajuntai-vos, povos, e sereis quebrados; e ouvi, todos vós que sois de terras distantes; vesti vossos cintos, e sereis quebrados; preparai vossos cintos para a batalha ,mas sereis quebrados.

versos.hebraico: עֻ֥צוּ עֵצָ֖ה וְתֻפָ֑ר דַּבְּר֤וּ דָבָר֙ וְלֹ֣א יָק֔וּם כִּ֥י עִמָּ֖נוּ אֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand: for God is with us.”
controles.kjv: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.
controles.livre: Reuni-vos para tomar conselho, mas ele será desfeito; falai alguma palavra, porém ela não se confirmará, porque Deus é conosco.

versos.hebraico: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י כְּחֶזְקַ֣ת הַיָּ֑ד וְיִסְּרֵ֕נִי מִלֶּ֛כֶת בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ הָֽעָם־הַזֶּ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: For Yahweh spoke thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,
controles.kjv: For the Lord spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,
controles.livre: Porque assim o SENHOR me disse com mão forte; e ele me ensinou a não andar pelo caminho deste povo, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תֹאמְר֣וּן קֶ֔שֶׁר לְכֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־יֹאמַ֛ר הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה קָ֑שֶׁר וְאֶת־מוֹרָא֥וֹ לֹֽא־תִֽירְא֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תַעֲרִֽיצוּ׃

controles.web: “Don’t say, ‘A conspiracy!’ concerning all about which this people say, ‘A conspiracy!’ neither fear their threats, nor be terrorized.
controles.kjv: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.
controles.livre: Não chameis de conspiração a tudo quanto este povo chama de conspiração; e não temais o que eles temem, nem vos assombreis.

versos.hebraico: אֶת־יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֹת֣וֹ תַקְדִּ֑ישׁוּ וְה֥וּא מוֹרַאֲכֶ֖ם וְה֥וּא מַֽעֲרִֽצְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
controles.kjv: Sanctify the Lord of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
controles.livre: Mas ao SENHOR dos exércitos, a ele santificai; e ele seja ele vosso temor, e ele seja vosso assombro.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֖ה לְמִקְדָּ֑שׁ וּלְאֶ֣בֶן נֶ֠גֶף וּלְצ֨וּר מִכְשׁ֜וֹל לִשְׁנֵ֨י בָתֵּ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְפַ֣ח וּלְמוֹקֵ֔שׁ לְיוֹשֵׁ֖ב יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

controles.web: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a trap and a snare for the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Então ele será como santuário para vós ; porém como pedra de ofensa, e por pedra de tropeço para as duas casas de Israel; como laço e como rede para os moradores de Jerusalém.

versos.hebraico: וְכָ֥שְׁלוּ בָ֖ם רַבִּ֑ים וְנָפְל֣וּ וְנִשְׁבָּ֔רוּ וְנוֹקְשׁ֖וּ וְנִלְכָּֽדוּ׃ס

controles.web: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”
controles.kjv: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
controles.livre: E muitos dentre eles tropeçarão e cairão; e serão quebrados, enlaçados, e presos.

versos.hebraico: צ֖וֹר תְּעוּדָ֑ה חֲת֥וֹם תּוֹרָ֖ה בְּלִמֻּדָֽי׃

controles.web: Wrap up the testimony. Seal the law among my disciples.
controles.kjv: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
controles.livre: Liga o testemunho; sela a Lei entre meus discípulos.

versos.hebraico: וְחִכִּ֨יתִי֙ לַיהוָ֔ה הַמַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנָ֖יו מִבֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְקִוֵּ֖יתִֽי־לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
controles.kjv: And I will wait upon the Lord, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
controles.livre: Esperarei ao SENHOR, que esconde seus rosto da casa de Jacó; e a ele aguardarei.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֗י וְהַיְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָֽתַן־לִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְאֹת֥וֹת וּלְמוֹפְתִ֖ים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֵעִם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הַשֹּׁכֵ֖ן בְּהַ֥ר צִיּֽוֹן׃ס

controles.web: Behold, I and the children whom Yahweh has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from Yahweh of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.
controles.kjv: Behold, I and the children whom the Lord hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the Lord of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.
controles.livre: Eis aqui, eu e os filhos que o SENHOR me deu, somos como sinais e como maravilhas em Israel, pelo SENHOR dos exércitos, que habita no monte de Sião.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יֹאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵיכֶ֗ם דִּרְשׁ֤וּ אֶל־הָאֹבוֹת֙ וְאֶל־הַיִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים הַֽמְצַפְצְפִ֖ים וְהַמַּהְגִּ֑ים הֲלוֹא־עַם֙ אֶל־אֱלֹהָ֣יו יִדְרֹ֔שׁ בְּעַ֥ד הַחַיִּ֖ים אֶל־הַמֵּתִֽים׃

controles.web: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter:” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?
controles.kjv: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?
controles.livre: E quando vos disserem: Consultai aos que se comunicam com os mortos e aos encantadores que murmuram, sussurrando entre os dentes.Por acaso não deveria o povo consultar ao seu Deus? Perguntarão aos mortos por causa dos vivos?

versos.hebraico: לְתוֹרָ֖ה וְלִתְעוּדָ֑ה אִם־לֹ֤א יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ כַּדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין־ל֖וֹ שָֽׁחַר׃

controles.web: Turn to the law and to the testimony! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
controles.kjv: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.
controles.livre: Respondei : À Lei e ao testemunho!Se não falarem segundo esta palavra, não haverá amanhecer para eles.

versos.hebraico: וְעָ֥בַר בָּ֖הּ נִקְשֶׁ֣ה וְרָעֵ֑ב וְהָיָ֨ה כִֽי־יִרְעַ֜ב וְהִתְקַצַּ֗ף וְקִלֵּ֧ל בְּמַלְכּ֛וֹ וּבֵאלֹהָ֖יו וּפָנָ֥ה לְמָֽעְלָה׃

controles.web: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry; and it will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse by their king and by their God. They will turn their faces upward,
controles.kjv: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.
controles.livre: E passarão pela terra ,duramente oprimidos e famintos; e será que, quando tiverem fome e ficarem enfurecidos, então amaldiçoarão ao seu rei e ao seu Deus, olhando para cima.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט וְהִנֵּ֨ה צָרָ֤ה וַחֲשֵׁכָה֙ מְע֣וּף צוּקָ֔ה וַאֲפֵלָ֖ה מְנֻדָּֽח׃

controles.web: and look to the earth, and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.
controles.kjv: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.
controles.livre: E olhando para a terra, eis aflição e trevas; haverá angustiante escuridão, e para as trevas serão empurrados.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י לֹ֣א מוּעָף֮ לַאֲשֶׁ֣ר מוּצָ֣ק לָהּ֒ כָּעֵ֣ת הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן הֵקַ֞ל אַ֤רְצָה זְבֻלוּן֙ וְאַ֣רְצָה נַפְתָּלִ֔י וְהָאַחֲר֖וֹן הִכְבִּ֑יד דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַיָּם֙ עֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן גְּלִ֖יל הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

controles.web: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.
controles.livre: Mas não haverá escuridão para aquela que foi angustiada tal como nos primeiros tempos, quando ele afligiu a terra de Zebulom e a terra de Naftali; mas depois ele a honrará junto ao caminho do mar, dalém do Jordão, a Galileia das nações.
